decision: keep each component's public props and look, swap its interactive internals for ui-sdk parts
why: user accepted departure from React; smallest change for library users

decision: Tabs first to prove ui-sdk on Solid 2 rc.21, jsdom (ui-sdk stubs in tests/setup.ts), vp pack externals and the playground
@ui-sdk/solid and @ui-sdk/core become peer dependencies (and dev dependencies)
why: ui-sdk asks the app and components to share one core copy

decision: caller-supplied trigger elements become ui-sdk triggers by spreading the part's props onto them in render
why: keeps the existing API and one tab stop

decision: DropdownMenu becomes the MenuContent panel and must sit inside DropdownMenuTrigger
why: ui-sdk menus are anchored top-layer popups

decision: RadioButton becomes an item inside RadioButtonGroup; name, selected, onSelect move to the group
why: ui-sdk RadioGroup owns value and roving focus

decision: modal stack dialogs use modal=trap-focus; titles come from the first Card/CardDouble h2; close returns focus
why: stack needs page clicks while a modal is open; dialogs need a name; dialogs unmount before ui-sdk restores focus
evidence: browser probe: Escape returns focus to the opener

decision: Dialog is an AlertDialog with trigger/open/defaultOpen, else an inline panel without role=dialog
why: keeps kitchen-sink and concept pages inline

decision: findNextFocusable skips tabindex=-1, disabled and aria-hidden
why: ui-sdk hidden form inputs were picked as focus targets

decision: kitchen sink and concept pages pixel-identical except slider thumb edge (100px), disabled button glyph antialias (132px), pre-existing window (3849px)
why: parity is the visual regression gate

decision: 23 interaction slices differ: ui-sdk menu placement, no pre-highlight on pointer-opened menus, focus moves into dialogs
SidebarLayout resize handle stays hand-rolled; Avatar, ScrollArea, ComboBox have no ui-sdk behavior to replace
why: Resizable sizes in percent, sacred in ch; the others hand-roll no behavior

decision: conventions test bans hand-written interactive roles in src
